name: Sprint 1
goal: Establish the core technical infrastructure and define the user experience for the customer loan application process.

name: Sprint 2
goal: Implement robust customer account management, secure application data storage, and comprehensive audit logging for system activities.

name: Sprint 3
goal: Develop the customer-facing loan application form and initiate the backend automated credit risk scoring process.

name: Sprint 4
goal: Complete the automated loan decision recommendation service and provide loan officers with a basic dashboard to view submitted applications.

name: Sprint 5
goal: Enhance the Loan Officer Dashboard with detailed application views and provide customers with real-time updates on their application status.

name: Sprint 6
goal: Implement the final critical feature allowing loan officers to manually override automated loan decisions.
